claim.claim-text: 1. A catalyst article for treating exhaust gas comprising:

a substrate comprising an inlet end and an outlet end with an axial length L; and a first catalytic region on the substrate; wherein the first catalytic region comprises a first PGM component and a first alumina, wherein the first alumina is doped with a first dopant of at least 5 wt.%, and wherein the first dopant is Ti.
2. The catalyst article of claim 1, wherein the dopant content in the first alumina is 5 wt. %-90 wt. %.
3. The catalyst article of claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the first dopant content in the first alumina is 5 wt. %-20 wt. %.
4. The catalyst article of claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the first dopant content in the first alumina is 20 wt. %-80 wt. %.
5. The catalyst article of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the first alumina is further stabilized with La.
6. The catalyst article of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the first PGM component is Rh.
7. The catalyst article of claim 6, wherein the first catalytic region is substantially free of PGMs other than Rh.
8. The catalyst article of any one of the preceding claims, further comprising a first oxygen storage capacity (OSC) material, and/or a first alkali or alkali earth metal component.
9. The catalyst article of any one of the preceding claims, wherein the first PGM component is supported on the first alumina.
10. The catalyst article of any one of the preceding claims, further comprising a second catalytic region.
11. The catalyst article of claim 10, wherein the second catalytic region comprises a second PGM component.
12. The catalyst article of claim 11, wherein the second PGM component is selected from the group consisting of Pd, Pt, Rh, and a mixture thereof.

13. The catalyst article of any one of claims 10-12, wherein the second catalytic region further comprises a second oxygen storage capacity (OSC) material, a second alkali or alkali earth metal component, and/or a second inorganic oxide.
14. The catalyst article of any one of claims 10-13, wherein the second catalytic region is supported/deposited directly on the substrate.
15. The catalyst article of claim 10-13, wherein the first catalytic region is supported/deposited on the second catalytic region.
16. An emission treatment system for treating a flow of a combustion exhaust gas comprising the catalyst article of any one of claims 1-15.
17. A method of treating an exhaust gas from an internal combustion engine comprising contacting the exhaust gas with the catalyst article of any one of claims 1-16.
